svg.text: the hole, forward and to the turtle's right
default 21 wide x 21 long x 16 high, from the turtle's
at floor level in one corner
coal for fuel; loot goes in here
• Needs GPS: a GPS constellation in range (gps-deployer) and a modem on the turtle.
• excavate 30 40 12 = 30 to the right, 40 forward, 12 up. 'excavate 21 21 16 down' digs downwards: put the turtle at the top
• Junk (cobblestone, dirt...) is dropped on the ground in front of the start; everything else goes in the chest.
